then.text: Sack's yours, with my blessing. Mind the Twin Otter. It's older than I am and a lot better looked after.
Mail sack for the Post Office? There, by the wall. Twenty kilos of postcards and one parcel that rattles. Don't ask.

else.text: Twin Otter on skis. Eighteen cylinders between two engines and a lot of faith. We keep the wheels for the runway and the skis for the rest of the continent.
The pilots do all the clever bit. I do the other clever bit, which is stopping them dying.
